---
name: Site request
about: A website or a kind of software you want itda to set up well
title: "site: <name>"
labels: site
---

## The site

Its public address, or the software it runs (GitLab, Jira, a wiki, a shop
platform...). Private intranet sites are fine: name the software and leave
the address out.

## What you tried

The `itda setup <url>` output, with your own names removed. If it asked you to
sign in or open the browser, say what happened next.

## What an agent should be able to do there

Three or four reads, and any change, in plain words:

- list what the notices page shows
- get one order by its number
- post a comment (a change)
